text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. Mejiro Ryan's 
heart races with excitement to let the 
muscles she has painstakingly trained roar 
into action.

However, her spirits quickly deflated when 
she thought about the other Umamusume who 
were making their debuts carrying 
everyone's hopes on their shoulders.

Unable to just stand by and watch her 
struggle, Ines Fujin came over to offer 
some words of encouragement.

Realizing that there were people out there 
cheering for her, Mejiro Ryan managed to 
regain her composure and headed out to the 
race.
